description: This file defines the PdfDocumentOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for handling PDF documents during save operations, including compression, color mode, and encoding modes.

classes.name: PdfDocumentOptions
classes.description: Holds options for handling how a PDF document is saved, including compression, color mode, and encoding preferences.

methods.name: PdfDocumentOptions(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor initializing PdfDocumentOptions with a PdfDocument instance.

methods.name: ColorMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the color mode used in the PDF document.

methods.name: CompressContentStreams
methods.description: Gets or sets whether to compress content streams within the PDF.

methods.name: NoCompression
methods.description: Indicates whether all objects are stored uncompressed.

methods.name: FlateEncodeMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the flate encode mode for compression, balancing between compression ratio and speed.

methods.name: EnableCcittCompressionForBilevelImages
methods.description: Indicates whether bilevel images should be compressed using CCITT compression.

methods.name: UseFlateDecoderForJpegImages
methods.description: Determines if JPEG images are compressed with the FlateDecode filter.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Specifies the layout mode for the PdfWriter during document writing.
